meta.title: 松下L10一周体验！让我的富士X100VI下岗了～
meta.title_en: One Week with the Panasonic L10: It Made My Fuji X100VI Redundant
meta.topic: 相机体验 · 街头摄影

scenes.title_en: Opening: My X100VI Got Laid Off
scenes.context: UP主用松下L10一周后，直接让富士X100VI下岗。开头先点题：这相机非常适合街头摄影和日常记录，好看的外表加优秀的性能，总让人有带出门拍摄的欲望。语域：评测口播，轻松口语。
sentences: 目前它也取代了富士X100VI，成为我街头的绝佳拍档。
It's already replaced my Fuji X100VI as my go-to companion on the streets.
replace（取代）；go-to companion（绝佳拍档）
好看的外表，优秀的性能，总让我有带出门拍摄的欲望。
A good-looking body and solid performance always make me want to take it out and shoot.
solid performance（优秀的性能）；take it out（带出门）
希望给也在关注松下L10的朋友一些参考。
I hope this gives some reference for anyone also eyeing the Panasonic L10.
eye on（关注）；give reference（给参考）
paraphrase: 绝佳拍档 → go-to companion / my trusty partner
go-to companion · trusty partner
给参考 → give some reference / offer some insight
give reference · offer insight
scenes.speak: It's already replaced my Fuji X100VI as my go-to companion on the streets. A good-looking body and solid performance always make me want to take it out and shoot. I hope this gives some reference for anyone also eyeing the Panasonic L10.

scenes.title_en: What Matters Most: Handling and Portability
scenes.context: 对于这类小相机，UP主不太在意画质参数，最看重操控性、便携性和对焦效率。L10体积和S9差不多，属于愿意日常带出门的范畴。还分享街头摄影小习惯：把相机放高一点，靠近时快速抓拍。语域：评测口播，经验分享。
sentences: 像这种相机，我一般最看重的就是它的操控性，还有便携性。
For a camera like this, what I care about most is its handling and portability.
handling（操控性）；portability（便携性）
并不算特别小的那种类型，但也是你愿意日常带出门的重量和体积。
It's not ultra-tiny, but it's a weight and size you'd be happy to carry every day.
ultra-tiny（特别小）；be happy to carry（愿意带出门）
我把相机尽量放到一个比较高的地方，靠近的时候很快地拍一张。
I try to hold the camera up a bit higher, and snap a shot quickly as I get close.
hold up higher（放高一点）；snap a shot（快速拍一张）
paraphrase: 操控性 → handling / ergonomics and controls
handling · controls
快速抓拍 → snap a shot quickly / grab a quick photo
snap a shot · grab a photo
scenes.speak: For a camera like this, what I care about most is its handling and portability. It's not ultra-tiny, but it's a weight and size you'd be happy to carry every day. I try to hold the camera up a bit higher, and snap a shot quickly as I get close.

scenes.title_cn: 物理操控：光圈环与自定义按键
scenes.title_en: Physical Controls: Aperture Ring and Custom Buttons
scenes.context: L10操控极好：直接转光圈环改光圈，曝光补偿按键自定义成快门速度，ISO可直接调，按曝光补偿键转拨盘可调补偿。FN开关默认切照片比例，UP主自定义成焦段切换，设为28/35/50mm最常用焦段。语域：评测口播，功能讲解。
sentences: 直接调节光圈环，就可以改变它的光圈。
Just turn the aperture ring, and you can change the aperture directly.
aperture ring（光圈环）；change the aperture（改变光圈）
我把曝光补偿的按键，设置成了一个快门速度的调节。
I mapped the exposure-compensation button to adjust the shutter speed instead.
map a button（按键自定义）；shutter speed（快门速度）
通过FN开关，就能快速切换焦段。
With the FN switch, I can quickly switch between focal lengths.
FN switch（功能开关）；focal length（焦段）
paraphrase: 按键自定义 → map the button / reassign the button
map the button · reassign
切换焦段 → switch focal lengths / change the focal length
switch focal lengths · change focal length
scenes.speak: Just turn the aperture ring, and you can change the aperture directly. I mapped the exposure-compensation button to adjust the shutter speed instead. With the FN switch, I can quickly switch between focal lengths.

scenes.context: L10背部有凸起手托，握持舒适，单手操作完全没问题。UP主还提到：从S5M2开始就不用担心松下的对焦了，L10已采用相位对焦，街头抓拍毫无压力。语域：评测口播，答疑口吻。
sentences: 它在背部有一个凸起，可以用来放大拇指，握持比较舒服。
There's a raised grip on the back where your thumb rests, making it comfortable to hold.
raised grip（凸起握持）；rest your thumb（放大拇指）
单手操作也完全没有问题。
One-handed operation is totally fine.
one-handed operation（单手操作）
它已经采用了相位对焦，所以街头抓拍一点问题都没有。
It uses phase-detection autofocus, so street snap-shooting is no problem at all.
phase-detection AF（相位对焦）；street snap-shooting（街头抓拍）
paraphrase: 握持舒服 → comfortable to hold / a nice grip
comfortable to hold · nice grip
毫无问题 → no problem at all / no trouble whatsoever
no problem at all · no trouble
scenes.speak: There's a raised grip on the back where your thumb rests, making it comfortable to hold. One-handed operation is totally fine. It uses phase-detection autofocus, so street snap-shooting is no problem at all.

scenes.title_en: Continuous AF and a Flip Screen
scenes.context: UP主设置连续对焦AFC模式，打开人脸识别，对象检测目标设为人眼。面对大型广告牌用24mm广角拍，能拍到有意思的画面。翻转屏也是考虑街头摄影相机的一个因素。语域：评测口播，实战分享。
sentences: 我设置的是连续对焦，也就是AFC的对焦模式，然后打开了人脸识别。
I set it to continuous autofocus — the AFC mode — and turned on face detection.
continuous autofocus（连续对焦）；face detection（人脸识别）
我把对象检测的目标，设定为人眼。
I set the subject-detection target to the eye.
subject detection（对象检测）；the eye（人眼）
翻转屏，也是我考虑街头摄影相机的一个因素。
A flip screen is also a factor I consider when choosing a street-photography camera.
flip screen（翻转屏）；a factor（一个因素）
paraphrase: 人脸识别 → face detection / face tracking
face detection · face tracking
考虑的因素 → a factor I consider / something I look for
a factor · something I look for
scenes.speak: I set it to continuous autofocus — the AFC mode — and turned on face detection. I set the subject-detection target to the eye. A flip screen is also a factor I consider when choosing a street-photography camera.

scenes.context: L10采用和S9一样的电池，一天的街头拍摄一块电池基本能搞定。搭载与M43旗舰GH7相同的背照式传感器、与S1M2相同的处理器，加上优秀降噪算法，高ISO下画质干净可用，夜晚街头也能出片，还有动态范围增强模式保留高光暗部细节。语域：评测口播，参数背书。
sentences: 一天的街头拍摄，基本上快电池就能搞定。
A full day of street shooting basically runs on a single battery.
a full day（一整天）；run on one battery（一块电池搞定）
优秀降噪算法的支持，让相机在高ISO情况下画质依然干净可用。
With its great noise reduction, the image stays clean and usable even at high ISO.
noise reduction（降噪算法）；clean and usable（干净可用）
动态范围增强模式，让高光和暗部的细节得以保留。
The dynamic-range boost mode preserves detail in both highlights and shadows.
dynamic-range boost（动态范围增强）；preserve detail（保留细节）
paraphrase: 一块电池搞定 → run on one battery / last all day on a battery
run on one battery · last all day
保留细节 → preserve detail / hold on to the details
preserve detail · hold detail
scenes.speak: A full day of street shooting basically runs on a single battery. With its great noise reduction, the image stays clean and usable even at high ISO. The dynamic-range boost mode preserves detail in both highlights and shadows.

scenes.title_cn: 街头摄影哲学：犹豫就拍
scenes.title_en: Street-Photo Philosophy: When in Doubt, Shoot
scenes.context: 街头摄影常有有意思的场景，但我们会犹豫，觉得拍下来不怎么样。UP主总结：既然犹豫了或发现了兴趣点，就应该拍下来，因为不知道那一刻会发生什么。拍砸了删掉就好。语域：评测口播，观点金句。
sentences: 我们往往看到一个想拍摄的场景，但是又会去犹豫。
We often spot a scene we want to shoot, but then we hesitate.
spot a scene（看到一个场景）；hesitate（犹豫）
既然你犹豫了，或者发现了兴趣点，你就应该把它拍下来。
Once you hesitate — or notice something interesting — you should just take the shot.
notice something interesting（发现兴趣点）；take the shot（拍下来）
拍出来是一张没有意思的照片，没有关系，我们把它删掉就好。
Even if it turns out to be a boring photo, that's fine — we can just delete it.
a boring photo（没意思的照片）；delete it（删掉）
paraphrase: 拍下来 → take the shot / press the shutter
take the shot · press the shutter
删掉就好 → just delete it / no harm done
just delete it · no harm done
scenes.speak: We often spot a scene we want to shoot, but then we hesitate. Once you hesitate — or notice something interesting — you should just take the shot. Even if it turns out to be a boring photo, that's fine — we can just delete it.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：从街头摄影的视角总结
scenes.context: UP主以街头摄影身份体验这台相机，关注的都跟街头摄影有关：便携性、可操控性、对焦、续航。如果还有其他方面想了解的，留言告诉他，会尽量回答大家的问题。语域：评测口播，总结收尾。
sentences: 今天我更多的是以街头摄影的身份，来体验这台相机。
Today I experienced this camera more from the perspective of a street photographer.
from the perspective of（以…的身份）
我关注的一些点，都跟街头摄影的相机有关。
The points I focused on all relate to cameras for street photography.
focus on（关注）；relate to（与…有关）
如果没有体现出来的话，我会尽量去回答大家的问题。
If anything wasn't covered in this video, I'll do my best to answer your questions.
not covered（没体现出来）；do my best（尽量）
paraphrase: 以…的身份 → from the perspective of / as a street photographer
from the perspective · as a street photographer
尽量回答 → do my best to answer / try my best to reply
do my best · try my best
scenes.speak: Today I experienced this camera more from the perspective of a street photographer. The points I focused on all relate to cameras for street photography. If anything wasn't covered in this video, I'll do my best to answer your questions.

practice: 说相机取代了另一台成为心头好
It's already replaced my Fuji X100VI as my go-to companion on the streets.
Just turn the aperture ring, and you can change the aperture directly.
A full day of street shooting basically runs on a single battery.
Once you hesitate — or notice something interesting — you should just take the shot.
pitfalls: The camera is very good to control.
「操控性好」英文用 handle well / handling，比 to control 更地道。
It can take photo in high ISO.
The image stays clean and usable even at high ISO.
强调高感下画质表现，用 The image stays clean（画面依然干净）更自然。
I set the focus to the eye of person.
I set the subject-detection target to the eye.
相机菜单语境用 subject detection target（检测目标），比口语说法更准确。
The camera is very small type.
It's not ultra-tiny, but it's a size you'd be happy to carry daily.
small type 是中式英语；用 compact / ultra-tiny 表达体积。
shifts: 说相机被替代只会 replaced
用 go-to companion（绝佳拍档）、made my X100VI redundant（让X100VI下岗）更生动
说对焦好只会 focus is good
用 phase-detection autofocus（相位对焦）、face detection（人脸识别）、continuous AF（连续对焦）
用 snap a shot（快速抓拍）、press the shutter（按下快门）、street snap-shooting（街头抓拍）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：M13/M4/3→M43、X1006→X100VI、S9、S5MR→S5M2、L10→L10、FN→FN、AFC→AFC、GH7→GH7、S1M2→S1M2、打电池→电池、退效→对焦效率、辨写→便携、八手→握把、接头→街头等。
